keyword: who has won the masters back to back
claims: Only four golfers in history have won the Masters back-to-back.
Jack Nicklaus won the Masters back-to-back in 1965-66.
Nick Faldo won the Masters back-to-back in 1989-90.
Tiger Woods won the Masters back-to-back in 2001-02.
Rory McIlroy won the Masters back-to-back in 2025-26.
Jack Nicklaus, Nick Faldo, Tiger Woods, and Rory McIlroy are the only individuals to successfully defend their title at Augusta National.
Jack Nicklaus was the first to win the Masters back-to-back.
Jack Nicklaus won the 1965 Masters by nine strokes.
Jack Nicklaus won the 1966 Masters in a playoff.
Nick Faldo won the 1989 Masters in a playoff.
Nick Faldo won the 1990 Masters in a playoff.
Tiger Woods accomplished winning the Masters back-to-back during his "Tiger Slam" era.
Rory McIlroy became the fourth player to win the Masters back-to-back.
